purpose: Operational county-by-county request packets for the New York county equivalents still outside normalized 2024 local President-versus-U.S.-Senate review coverage after Monroe County was reconciled and loaded in Wave 24. These packets are request/source tracking only; they do not load rows, promote production, or allege fraud or misconduct.
requestFields: official 2024 General Election local/election-district President rows
official same-grain 2024 General Election United States Senator rows
candidate, party, vote, total, blank, void, overvote, and undervote fields where available
county, town/city, ward, precinct, election district, poll site, and reporting-unit identifiers needed for joins
ballots-cast, voter-history, or voter-participation rows at county or election-district grain
registered-voter denominator and denominator timing, especially 11/01/2024 or election-day close-of-books context
map-ready precinct/election-district geometry or an official crosswalk matching result labels
post-election audit selection and comparison reports, CVR availability statements, recount, correction, incident, and litigation records where public
normalizationRules: Do not load packet-produced rows until the source authority, URL, local artifact path, reporting grain, parser path, expected row count, totals, caveats, and confidence notes are recorded.

Reconcile parsed President and U.S. Senate local rows to the official county totals in data/ny-2024-general-president.csv and data/ny-2024-general-senate.csv before changing data/ny-2024-local-review.csv.
Treat NYSBOE enrollment reports as denominator leads only until paired with ballots-cast, voter-history, or voter-participation rows.
Treat Flateau/VEDA as a future official statewide export path unless NYSBOE publishes qualifying historical 2024 exports.
